# `operation-removed-after-deprecation`

Operation removed after the deprecation period

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `operation-removed-after-deprecation` |
| **Status** | Planned (M6) |
| **Group** | Paths and operations ([RULES.md section 2](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

An operation was removed after it had been deprecated for the configured period, or after its sunset date.

## Why this default

Clients were warned for the agreed period, so the removal follows the API lifecycle.

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml

```
